Bill.BriefDescription: Allowing employers to pay a training wage for a specified period of time.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to preventing the curtailment of employmentopportunities by allowing employers to pay a training wage for aspecified period of time; and adding a new section to chapter 49.46RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 49.46 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The director shall establish procedures for the issuance of specialtraining certificates to employers to pay wages to new employees duringa training period at seventyfive percent of the minimum wage requiredunder RCW 49.46.020 or the minimum wage rate required under federallaw, whichever is greater. The following restrictions apply to the useof the training certificates: (1) The training period may last for a maximum of six hundredeighty hours; (2) Employers may only use this special training certificate onceper employee; (3) Only employers with fifty employees or fewer may use thespecial training certificate; p. 1 HB 1150 (4) Employees working under this special training certificate maynot constitute more than ten percent of an employer's workforce, exceptthat employers with fewer than ten employees may employ one employee ata time using the special training certificate; and (5) If an employer discharges an employee working under the specialtraining certificate prior to the completion of six hundred eightyhours, the employer must notify the director and provide an explanationfor the discharge. The employer may not replace the dischargedemployee with another employee working under a special trainingcertificate for one year from the date of the discharge.
